Daily-Technology Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the daily-technology content generation skill.
- Generates 60-90 second TikTok scripts and social media content about major tech news from the past 24 hours.
- Aggregates free tech news sources with category and topic filters (AI, startups, gadgets, etc.).
- Provides innovation impact scoring, funding tracking, and product release significance analysis.
- Offers customizable templates, trending hashtags, and platform-optimized script formatting.
- Supports advanced usage and scheduling via editable configuration files.
